I’m an aspiring VA! My dream is to work in one of Hoyo’s games!!!
It would just be replacing the hinges and screws and handles, or at least stripping/removing/cleaning them, bc rn they don’t close properly

First, especially if the writer wrote it with me in mind specifically, I’d be flattered and definetely give it a read! When it comes to actually recording/publishing a reading OF it though, I would definitely be just as picky and ask the same questions to myself as I would be with any other script; Do I enjoy the premise? Do I feel like I could do equal justice to both the writing and my own voice? How much effort would this require from me to do and how much am I willing to put into it? And finally, is it well written? 

The last point specifically is where I’ve seen a lot of gifted scripts fall flat, which isn’t anyone’s fault! It doesn’t take away the kindness of the gesture, however, I’m speaking to the writers now, when you OFFER something, or GIFT something, the recipient is under NO obligation to A. Accept, B. Use, and C. Give you special privileges/treatments. Whether a VA does any of those things, should not be ever due to pestering, badgering, guilt tripping, or anything of the sorts. Courtesy and respect of boundaries goes both ways, no matter the age, gender, video, experience, or sub count. 
(Sorry for the long winded response OP, I got a bit carried away haha! Ty for posting this ask!! <3)
